high_level_description: A 1600x900 sun-dappled meadow landscape with an ancient oak on the right featuring a low horizontal branch pointing toward center, a rusted fence in the left background, a tiny clock tower in the distant center-top skyline, and a small drone in the upper sky — all arranged to leave the center, left foreground, and area near the oak’s base intentionally empty.

style_description.aesthetics: Serene, pastoral, lightly whimsical structural blueprint
style_description.lighting: Bright daylight with soft overhead sun casting subtle dapples
style_description.photo: Wide-angle landscape, 16:9 aspect ratio, structural SVG blueprint

compositional_deconstruction.background: Sky (top 500px) and meadow (bottom 400px); sun dapples are translucent circles scattered across upper meadow.

elements.desc: sky background, light blue solid fill
meadow ground, light green solid fill
rusted fence in left background: six vertical posts and two horizontal rails
clock tower in distance: base, shaft, clock face, and roof silhouette
small drone in upper sky: black 'X' with central square
ancient oak on right: brown trunk and layered green canopy with one low horizontal branch extending left
